description: Builds a changelog from two lists. Pass `before` and `after` as lines (`name: value` or just `name`) or JSON (flat or nested objects, W3C-style tokens with $value, or arrays of names). Returns added items grouped by prefix, changed values phrased with the real change (color from-to, pixel difference), probable renames guessed from similar names or identical values (confirm each), removed items, counts, and a suggested semantic-version bump (removals and renames suggest major, additions minor, value changes patch; a convention). Optional `version` and `title` head the output. It compares only the text you give it and cannot see visual changes that are not in the lists.
name: write_design_changelog
title: Design changelog
